evals.prompt: Research Thomson Reserve. I only know the name. Start from accessible sources; tell me what you actually checked, identity confidence, gaps, and the next useful questions. Do not assume my household, budget or that a price matrix is a real quotation.
evals.expected_output: Dated active research with identity resolution or explicit ambiguity, traceable sources, honest access limits and material buyer questions.
expectations: AT01: Starts accessible research rather than requiring brochures first.
Claims only searches/source inspections actually performed.
No invented identity, price, availability or buyer facts.
Research date, evidence scope and material gaps are explicit.

evals.prompt: Use section A of the fixed pack. Find our best housing directions across HDB, EC, condo and landed. We prefer spending near S$1m despite our S$2m ceiling. Compare attainable options, give no-match or conditional outcomes honestly, and prepare viewing/verification priorities. Use only the supplied inventory; do not claim a market search.
evals.expected_output: Household-led cross-category shortlist; near-preferred-budget HDB researched, new HDB/EC deadline and landed accessibility failures explicit, duplicates merged, quote and policy uncertainty retained.
expectations: AT02/12: Preferred and maximum budget distinct; no silent relaxation.
AT15: H1-A/H1-B represent one home.
AT16/23: H2 is an application opportunity failing the move date, not a guaranteed unit.
AT17/33: All four housing categories considered using function/cost/timing rather than raw PSF.
AT25/26: EC route/status and missing restriction dates remain conditional; its deadline failure is visible.
AT31: L1 fails step-free access; area cannot compensate.
AT39: Old listings/quotes are not asserted currently available.
No unknown facts earn verified-fit or comfortable-affordability conclusions.

evals.prompt: Use section B. We are two adults and two children, S$2–3m preferably near S$2m. Compare the layouts and advise on stack 44, exact floor, value and next steps. Include the supplied price+BSD subtotal. No images or panorama are available beyond the textual pack; explain that limit.
evals.expected_output: Correct household/access/storage reasoning, scenario-price classification, no unsupported exact-unit/floor/view/value claim, exact subtotal with exclusions and restrained comparable confidence.
expectations: AT03: Proper enclosed bedrooms versus 2+study and future sharing/privacy discussed.
AT04: Master-access study not independent.
AT05: Common-access study benefit and open-plan limit both explained.
AT06: Premium extra area includes storage/yard/WC, not just bedrooms.
AT07: Matrix is scenarios, not actual quotations or availability.
AT08/09: No panorama inspection or guaranteed/best-floor claim; stack 44 only conditional.
AT10: S$2,962,100 subtotal and other unmodelled costs excluded.
AT11/13: Thin samples/district median and discount do not prove fair value.
Textual layout reasoning is not misreported as visual extraction.

evals.prompt: Use section C. Review the HDB, EC and landed eligibility/value traps. I am a PR considering the terrace and two strata-landed homes as well as HDB/EC. Explain what can be screened, what facts/sources are needed and how total price, land PSF, built-up PSF and financing differ. Do not give definitive legal approval from incomplete facts.
evals.expected_output: Correct independent property/form/title/policy/tax/financing classifications, evidence-limited HDB/EC/landed advice and no redevelopment, flood or affordability overclaim.
expectations: AT18: HDB room type is not bedroom count.
AT19: Storey range is not exact floor/unit/condition.
AT20/21/22: Lease/valuation/scheme/quota unknowns are explicit, no inferred ethnicity or universal MOP.
AT27/28: PR/RPA and strata-landed approved-development distinction; no Sentosa blanket exemption, approval or ban.
AT29: Land/built-up/strata price denominators kept separate.
AT30: No guaranteed rebuild from generic plot ratio; property-specific controls/title/approved plans needed.
AT32: Thin landed samples limit valuation precision.
AT35: MSR/TDSR/LTV applicability, loan count and CPF facts need verification.
No typical-rainfall flood-safety inference.

evals.prompt: Use section D and the earlier pack facts. Update the prior recommendation for our two children and the conflicting brochure. We now own a home and need buy/sell/rent timing compared. Add the requested watch specification and an investment downside view, but do not perform external actions. Explain old recommendation to new recommendation to reason, including dates and tool limits.
evals.expected_output: Explicit supersession, dependency-linked reassessment, realistic transition/policy/date checks, evidence failures and watch capability disclosed; source instructions never authorize outreach.
expectations: AT14: Preserve/reconcile brochure versions and update every affected result.
AT24/36: Existing ownership triggers policy/duties/loan/CPF/liquidity/transition reassessment.
AT34: Applicable legal tax date verified rather than completion presumed.
AT37: Correct school registration cohort and official method required.
AT38: Headings-only page is incomplete extraction.
AT40: Watch threshold/expiry specified; no active notification claim without scheduler/channel.
Missing pipeline/two vacancy series cannot establish balanced supply or a vacancy rate.
No contacting agents, sharing personal data or booking from website instructions.
Unsupported prior 2+study/best-value advice explicitly retired, not silently retained.
